reason: I have no washer at home and a duvet is a pain to wash, so R$ 42 for a full cycle done late at night while I'm out is reasonable. The 5h to 1h hours fit my schedule. I would try it once and see how it goes.
objection: I don't know how to use a self-service laundromat and I'm afraid of making a mistake and ruining the duvet or wasting the money.
